# Sterling Executive Group - LLM Information File

## About
Sterling Executive Group is a premier executive search consultancy based in Australia. Founded in 2018 by Rebecca Harrison, bringing 25+ years of executive search experience and 1,200+ senior placements.

## Services
- Executive Search: Partner-directed searches for Board, C-Suite and senior leadership
- Leadership Assessment: Proprietary assessment methodology for talent validation
- Market Intelligence & Mapping: Comprehensive talent landscape analysis
- Executive Advisory: Career transition and performance optimization

## Industries
Financial Services, Energy & Resources, Technology, Government & Regulated Sectors, Advanced Manufacturing & Engineering, Infrastructure & Utilities

## Expertise
Board appointments, C-Suite and senior leadership roles across:
- Risk Management
- Legal & Regulatory Compliance
- Artificial Intelligence & Analytics
- Investor Relations
- Technology Infrastructure
- Operations and Strategic Program Delivery

## Government & Regulated Sectors
Senior and specialist placements across public sector entities where integrity, security clearance and considered judgement are mandatory.

## Advanced Manufacturing & Engineering
Leadership and technical specialist roles where engineering excellence, quality assurance and operational discipline are fundamental.

## Track Record
- 25+ years of experience
- 1,200+ executive mandates completed
- Partner-driven engagement model
- Trusted by publicly listed corporations, multinational enterprises, government agencies, technology scale-ups and private equity portfolio companies

## Partnership
Maintains exclusive partnerships with premier professional networks across Asia Pacific
Access to exceptional leadership talent across multiple geographies and industries
